scenarios.title: Job select creates a Hero token and attaches the Equipment to it

setup.notes: Warrior's Sword gives equipped creature +3/+2 and the Warrior type. B's four lands are untapped.

decisions: A casts Warrior's Sword (3R), tapping four Mountains.
Both players pass; Warrior's Sword resolves and enters the battlefield.
The job select trigger goes on the stack; both players pass and it resolves.

variants.label: resolves
variants.expected: Warrior's Sword enters, a 1/1 colorless Hero creature token is created and Warrior's Sword is attached to it. The Hero is a 4/3 Warrior.

variants.label: equipment_destroyed_in_response
variants.delta: In response to the job select trigger, B casts Shatter targeting Warrior's Sword, tapping both Mountains.
variants.expected: Warrior's Sword is destroyed and moves to A's graveyard. The trigger still resolves: a 1/1 colorless Hero token is created and has nothing attached.

variants.label: spell_countered
variants.delta: B casts Counterspell targeting Warrior's Sword while it is on the stack, tapping both Islands.
variants.expected: Warrior's Sword is countered and moves to A's graveyard. It never enters the battlefield, so no job select trigger happens and no Hero token is created.
